days.file: Johannes (Jan) Vermeer - Christ in the House of Martha and Mary - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
days.alt: Martha stands over a table with a basket of bread, leaning toward Jesus, who gestures toward Mary seated at His feet.
days.look: Look again at Martha with the bread, bent toward Jesus. What would you set down before you serve?
days.license: Artist died 1675; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Vincent van Gogh - The sower - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Sower
days.alt: A sower in a green coat strides across a plowed field under a huge yellow sun, scattering seed.
days.look: Look again at the sower’s hand in the seed bag. What have you planted that you can now leave to God to grow?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Gerard David - The Marriage at Cana.jpg
days.title: The Marriage at Cana
days.alt: At a wedding feast, a servant in red kneels beside large stone jars holding out a cup, while another pours from a jug and the guests sit at table.
days.look: Look again at the jars before the servants. What plain task is He asking you to fill to the brim?
days.license: Artist died 1523; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Lawrence Distributing Alms
days.alt: St. Lawrence, in a deacon’s rich robe, hands alms to a line of poor men, women and children who reach toward him.
days.look: Look again at Lawrence’s open hands and the poor reaching toward them. Whose need could you serve in His name today?
days.license: Artist died 1455; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Cecilia
days.alt: St. Cecilia looks up toward heaven, holding a violin and bow against her red dress.
days.look: Look again at Cecilia’s upturned face. To whom is your song really sung?
days.license: Artist died 1642; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Jesus Washing Peter’s Feet
days.alt: Jesus kneels in a green robe and washes the foot of an older bearded Peter, who bows his head.
days.look: Look again at Christ kneeling at Peter’s feet. If He bends this low for you, what worry can you cast on Him?
days.license: Artist died 1893; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt van Rijn (and Workshop?), The Apostle Paul, c. 1657, NGA 1198.jpg
days.title: The Apostle Paul
days.alt: The elderly, bearded Paul rests his tired head on his hand, a sword standing behind him.
days.look: Look again at Paul’s head resting on his hand. What weakness could you lay before Christ today?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: CC0)

days.file: Jean-François Millet - Gleaners - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Gleaners
days.alt: Three peasant women bend low in a wide field of cut wheat, gathering what is left, while far behind them the harvest is piled high.
days.look: Look again at the women bent over the field. Who could you ask the Lord of the harvest to send?
days.license: Artist died 1875; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Pentecost
days.alt: Light pours down on Mary and the apostles gathered in a hall as the Spirit descends.
days.look: Look again at the light falling on them. What would you give back to Him with thanks?
days.license: Artist died 1768; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
